panels.title: A1 - Weekly active users (distinct device_id)

targets.expr: count(count by (attributes_device_id) (count_over_time({service_name="lichtblick"} | json | body="Studio: App Initialized" [7d])))

panels.description: Distinct anonymous devices that started a session in the window. Loki lines are JSON, so the parser is | json (not logfmt) and the event name is the AppEvent text in `body`; device_id lives in the line body, never as a metric label.

panels.title: A2 - Session duration (p50/p95, derived from heartbeat)
panels.description: Per-session duration is a gauge refreshed on every heartbeat (no reliance on an end-of-session event). max_over_time gives how long each session reached within the range; quantile() then takes percentiles across sessions.

panels.title: A4 - Renderer heap (gauge, resolution <= 30s)
panels.description: Renderer JS heap. The `_bytes` suffix comes from the instrument's UCUM unit (By) declared in eventRouting.ts METRIC_UNITS.

panels.title: A5 - Renderer gone, by reason
panels.description: Every abnormal renderer exit, grouped by reason — never filtered to reason="oom". A V8 heap OOM does not necessarily surface as "oom": an isolated probe on macOS reported reason="crashed" (exit code 5) for `V8 javascript OOM (Reached heap limit)`, and since StudioWindow runs with sandbox:false the renderer carries a Node environment, so the OOM can instead come through Node's handler. Filtering on a single reason silently hides the event we most care about.
